properties.accuracyNote: The lots the Planning Department's record for the approved project names, "Block 3778; Lots 1B, 2B, 4, 5, 47, and 48" (2017-000663PRJ), and the Central SoMa Plan (2018), Key Development Site Guidelines maps as Site 4, "Flower Mart", on Brannan Street between Fifth and Sixth streets. A 2016 Planning record (2015-004256PPA-04) gives the site as 295,144 sq ft (6.78 acres). The revised project filed in 2025 (2025-008569PRJ) doesn't list its lots. 6.8 acres as drawn.
